'; cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id; elif command -v sysctl >/dev/null 2>&1 && sysctl -n kern.boottime >/dev/null 2>&1; then printf 'source=bsd-boottime

' '__HARBOR_ANTRIEB_UNSUPPORTED__: boot-identity'; fi
